lines.t: Thank you so much for joining us.
You will never know the stone cold grave
Nor hang from a criminal's tree
Never taste that severed breath
When heaven seemed far from me
You will never sweat out drops of blood
In a garden pressed alone
Never hear brutes haggle your garments
Hung bears trip down to bone
As they pierced my side and lifted me high
Arms open wide between earth and sky
I was brought down low in my passion
I bore that hour to make you mine
My blood runs down, my tears run down, love does not turn away
My blood runs down, my tears run down, I bore the price that day
I hope you never feel what I feel when the earth is filled with violence
When rivers of tears and blood run dry
And heaven answers silence
My heart is very heavy
I take no pleasure at all
As my hand draws back in anger
Tears continue to fall
My blood runs down and they refuse it
My tears fall like rain, yet they turn away
They heap up death with a will in hand
Still they choose it, they choose death
We'll be right back.
face my tears run down as they pierce my side blood and tears run down together
as my own people driving the nails i am lifted from my place
I'm spread apart
Waiting still to receive them in embrace
Oh my people why
Why have you forsaken me
You forsake me
You forsake me
Forsake me
Oh, I forsake me
Oh, I forsake me
This sorrow will not rise again
This ruin must not remain
Love will purge what love must purge
Death cannot reign
I take no pleasure in what must be done
No pleasure at all
Evil will not stall forever
Our tears will cease to fall
Fall
Fall
My blood runs down, my tears run down
But not for endless years
My blood runs down, my tears run down
Purging sorrows and fears
I am come down
Not divided in my heart
Love that bled for you
Now takes man's kingdoms apart
I am
I am
I am
I am come down, down, down
Down, down, down
Thank you.
